normalizer.featureNames: Unigram token or two adjacent tokens separated by one ASCII space; unique names are sorted in ascending ASCII lexicographic order.
normalizer.featureTokens: The normalized tokens in original order, including request stopwords and repeated words.
steps: Reject a non-string, raw code-point/UTF-8 byte limit violation, NUL or a lone surrogate; never truncate.

Trim only ASCII spaces and tabs from both ends; require the complete trimmed text to match rawFullMatchRegex using ASCII semantics. No other Unicode, digits, symbols, line breaks or punctuation are accepted.
Convert ASCII A-Z to a-z, remove at most the one permitted final period/exclamation/question mark, replace each internal hyphen with an ASCII space, and collapse runs of spaces/tabs to one space.

Split on ASCII spaces. Internal apostrophes remain part of the token. Reject empty input or more than 64 tokens. Do not perform stemming, Unicode folding, stopword removal, clause removal or prefix salvage.

rejectionPolicy.canonicalAnchorRule: Reject when two or more distinct canonical anchor sequences occur as contiguous whole-token sequences. This is a veto only; it never chooses or returns an intent.
rejectionPolicy.emptyFeaturesRule: Reject a zero-norm vector after fixed-vocabulary vectorization.
rejectionPolicy.limitations: These vetoes are conservative, incomplete semantic checks. Score gates and independent unsupported evaluation must still reject requests that use known words in an unsupported meaning. No rule directly accepts an input.
rejectionPolicy.unknownContentRule: Derive known content tokens solely from all normalized supported training texts before vocabulary truncation. Reject every token outside that set and requestStopwords; require at least one non-stopword token. Development/held-out tokens never extend this set.
